title: Rapid DNA Extraction from Sediment Using Spin Columns
author: Linda Armbrecht

steps.title: Prepare Tubes
steps.instruction: Wipe the outside of the tubes, especially along the rim, with 80% ethanol to prevent contamination and label the tubes clearly.

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Perform initial sample lysis and incubation (typically completed by tutors 24 hours prior).

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL lysis buffer to the sample.
Vortex briefly to mix sediments with lysis buffer.
Incubate on a rotator at 10 rpm for 17 hours (overnight) at room temperature.

steps.title: Separate Lysate from Sediment
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes to separate the lysate from undigested sample material.

substeps.instruction: Clean the centrifuge rotor surface with ethanol.
Ensure the centrifuge is balanced with an even number of tubes containing the same volume of liquid, arranged opposite each other.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 16,400 g.
Transfer the supernatant (lysate) to a fresh 1.7 mL tube, taking care not to touch or transfer any sediment pellet.

steps.title: Prepare Supernatant for Loading
steps.instruction: Add Solution C4 to the supernatant and mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 1200 µL of Solution C4 (50-70% guanidinhydrochlorid + 1-10% isopropylalcohol) to the supernatant.
Vortex for 5 s.

steps.title: Load Spin Column
steps.instruction: Load the supernatant onto a spin column in three separate aliquots.

substeps.instruction: Load the first 675 µL of supernatant onto a spin column, centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 min at room temperature, and discard the flow-through.
Load the second 675 µL of supernatant onto the spin column, centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 min at room temperature, and discard the flow-through.
Load the remaining supernatant onto the spin column, centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 min at room temperature, and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Wash Filter Membrane
steps.instruction: Remove contaminants and residues from the filter membrane using Solution C5.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Solution C5 (70% ethanol) to the spin column.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 30 s at room temperature and discard the flow-through.
Centrifuge again at 10,000 x g for 1 min at room temperature and discard the flow-through and collection tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the bound DNA from the filter membrane into a clean tube.

substeps.instruction: Carefully place the spin column in a clean 1.7 mL tube, touching only the rim to avoid contamination.
Add 25 µL of Elution Buffer (EB / C6 buffer) to the center of the white filter membrane without touching the membrane with the pipette tip.
Let sit for at least 2 minutes, ensuring the membrane has fully soaked up the buffer.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 30 s.
Discard the spin column and retain the tube containing the extracted DNA.

steps.title: Final Processing and Storage
steps.instruction: Combine extracts and store the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Combine the replicate sediment DNA extracts into one tube (~75 µL total).
Keep the control extract in a separate tube.
Store the DNA extract and control in a labeled rack or cryo box in the freezer at -20 °C.
